A simple and fun plugin: breaking certain blocks will spawn a random mob next to the player!​

# Description
Breaking a certain block has a chance of spawning a random mob around the player.
Currently, the blocks are: stone, cobblestone, and deep shale.
Mobs are configurable in the config.
